item.title: Eclipse Theia
item.author: xxxx
item.description:
Eclipse Theia
https://theia-ide.org/
Cloud & Desktop IDE Platform
Eclipse Theia is an extensible platform to develop multi-language Cloud & Desktop IDEs with state-of-the-art web technologies.

Repo: https://github.com/eclipse-theia/theia

Cloud & Desktop

Not sure whether you need a web or desktop version or both?

With Theia you can develop one IDE and run it in browsers or native desktop application from a single source.

Vendor Neutral

The Theia project is hosted at the Eclipse Foundation, a not-for-profit corporation, and is developed by a diverse community.

item.title: Project Lombok - Never write another getter or equals method again
item.author: xxxx
item.description:
Project Lombok
https://projectlombok.org/
Project Lombok is a java library that automatically plugs into your editor and build tools, spicing up your java.
Never write another getter or equals method again. Early access to future java features such as val, and much more.
